newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Natl Mutual, Westpac offer mortgage pack.
newsitem.headline: Natl Mutual, Westpac offer mortgage pack.

text.p: National Mutual Insurance Co Ltd (NMI), part of Hong Kong-listed National Mutual Asia Ltd, and Westpac Banking Group said on Monday they were teaming up to offer a mortgage-insurance package to Asian investors in Australasia.

The "mortgage reducing time assurance plan" offers mortgage life insurance protection to Westpac clients, who had taken out or planned to take out mortgages on properties in Australia and New Zealand, the companies said in a joint statement.

They said clients could choose between cover which paid out the full outstanding capital and interest on their mortgage either in the event of death or total disability, or which paid out on death or diagnosis of one of 30 major illnesses.
Clients who repaid their mortgages before maturity would receive a surrender value to compensate them, the companies said.

National Mutual and Westpac were targeting the growing wave of Asian investment in property in both Australia and New Zealand, said Peter Chan, Westpac's country head and chief manager, Hong Kong branch and regional.
In Hong Kong, investment in Australasian properties probably represented 50 percent to 55 percent of the bank's personal and private banking business, Chan said.

He said Asian purchasers represented about 95 percent of the purchasers of Australian properties valued at A$1.5 million or above, and a similar proportion invested in higher-end New Zealand properties.
The package would initially only be offered in Hong Kong, he said.
Mark Pearson, NMI's chief executive, life insurance, said it was the first time National Mutual Asia had entered such an agreement with a bank.
National Mutual Asia and NMI are part of National Mutual Holding Ltd, which is part of the AXA group.
